title: Packing for a trip together

fn.en: Say what you prefer and why, and agree or disagree politely.

useful: I’m sorry, but I don’t agree.

lines: We need [cooking|cook|cooked] equipment, [because|so|but] we have to eat. 🍳

sub.en: Look at the sentences. What form follows prefer, and what follows would rather?

items.why: would prefer + to + verb.  would rather + verb, with no “to”.
prefer A to B — for a general preference, no “would”.

acts.title: Five things, three people, one bag
text: ALIYA: “The most important thing is the first-aid kit. I’d rather carry it myself. A torch is more useful than a compass, because we’re following a river, not crossing a desert.”
TIMUR: “I don’t agree about the compass. Phones die. But I’d prefer to take one stove instead of three — they’re heavy and we eat together anyway.”
ZHANNA: “A lighter is lighter than a stove — that’s the whole point. We can cook on a fire. And I’d rather sleep under the stars than carry a third tent.”
They agreed on four things in ten minutes and argued about the fifth for two hours. In the end they took the stove.

write.q: You are packing one bag for three people. Choose five things and write 6 sentences: say what you prefer, compare two things, name the most important one, and give two reasons with because or so.
write.model: I’d prefer to take one tent, because three are too heavy for one bag. I think a torch is better than a compass, because we’re following a river. The most important thing is the first-aid kit, so I’d rather carry it myself. We need a stove, because the wood in the forest is often wet. I’d rather leave the cooking equipment at home. Five things is not many, so we have to agree quickly.

speak.q: Argue for your five things out loud. Use “I’d prefer to…”, “I’d rather…”, one comparative, one superlative, and disagree politely with one idea.
speak.model: I’d prefer to take one stove. I’d rather sleep in a tent than in a hotel. A compass is better than a GPS. The most important thing is water. — I’m sorry, but I don’t agree about the third torch.
